description: This Java class defines the Adapter configuration properties used within the Eclipse Hono device registry management API. It includes properties for enabling/disabling the adapter, specifying the adapter type, device authentication requirements, and extension properties. The class provides fluent API methods for configuration management.

classes.name: Adapter
classes.description: Configuration class representing an Adapter schema object for device registry management, supporting properties like type, enabled status, device authentication requirement, and extension properties.

methods.name: Adapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing Adapter with a specific type, requiring the 'type' parameter.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Sets whether the adapter is enabled for device connections.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the adapter is enabled.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type string of the adapter.

methods.name: setDeviceAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Sets whether device authentication is required when connecting via this adapter.

methods.name: isDeviceAuthenticationRequired
methods.description: Checks if device authentication is required.

methods.name: setExtensions
methods.description: Replaces existing extensions with a new set of extension properties.

methods.name: getExtensions
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable view of the adapter's extension properties.

methods.name: putExtension
methods.description: Adds or replaces a single extension property by key.
